label: SET 1 Agreement
centralQuestion: Does remote work reduce the daily commuting time that employees spend traveling to a workplace?

sources.title: Remote Work and Daily Commutes
sources.summary: Discusses how remote arrangements change employee travel patterns.
sources.thesis: Remote work reduces employee commuting time compared to office-only schedules.
sources.centralQuestion: Remote work reduces employee commuting time compared to office-only schedules.

claims.statement: Remote work reduces the amount of time employees spend commuting to a central workplace each day.
claims.evidenceSummary: Remote work reduces the amount of time employees spend commuting to a central workplace each day. Workers who stay home avoid rush-hour traffic and repeated round trips that previously consumed hours every week.

conclusions: Remote work reduces employee commuting time compared to office-only schedules.

evidence.text: Remote work reduces the amount of time employees spend commuting to a central workplace each day. Workers who stay home avoid rush-hour traffic and repeated round trips that previously consumed hours every week.

sources.title: Home Offices and Travel Time
sources.summary: Explains travel eliminated when employees work from home.
sources.thesis: Working from home removes much of the daily workplace travel employees used to make.
sources.centralQuestion: Working from home removes much of the daily workplace travel employees used to make.

claims.statement: Working from home cuts much of the daily travel that employees otherwise make to their office.
claims.evidenceSummary: Working from home cuts much of the daily travel that employees otherwise make to their office. Teams report reclaiming time previously lost to buses, trains, and highway commutes.

conclusions: Working from home removes much of the daily workplace travel employees used to make.

sources.title: Rolling Out Remote Policies
sources.summary: Covers implementation costs of remote work programs.
sources.thesis: Remote rollouts require new tooling and training investments.
sources.centralQuestion: Remote rollouts require new tooling and training investments.

claims.statement: Organizations rolling out remote work must budget for secure collaboration tools and employee training.
claims.evidenceSummary: Organizations rolling out remote work must budget for secure collaboration tools and employee training. These rollout costs are separate from whether employees save time on commuting.

conclusions: Remote rollouts require new tooling and training investments.
